statement: Before and after are two runs of scripts/benchmark_access_points.py on the same machine with the same arguments (--sizes 512 1024 --tiling-size 1024 --registry-features 2000). 'Before' is the first working implementation; 'after' is the committed code. Between the two runs the basin footprint definition and the perimeter estimator were also corrected, so the delineation workload is not byte-identical; the optimisation itself (discarding sub-threshold basins before measuring shape) was verified to give identical output on the control scenes before those corrections were made.

comparison.measure: registry ingest with rule checks, 2,000 features
service query: feature page of 100 (median), 2,000 features
service query: bounding-box page of 100 (median), 2,000 features
service query: evidence for one feature (median), 2,000 features
load and verify registry document, 2,000 features

not_compared: There is no earlier implementation of closed-basin delineation, of the registries or of the query service in this repository, so there is no pre-existing baseline to compare against.
